about: BI1 routing cases over the shared library ~/.agents/skills. Each prompt names the one skill that should fire (expect; null when none should) and the near misses it is easily confused with. Synthetic prompts only.

cases.prompt: Make me a one-pager PDF summarising this quarter's reading list, something I can print and pin up.
Turn my notes on the garden irrigation project into a short presentation deck I can share with my neighbours.
Design a poster for the book club's winter meetup with a strong visual style.
Draw an isometric illustration of how a message queue works, as a physical machine, for my blog post.
I need an interactive SVG figure explaining a rate limiter as a real object for our docs page.
Make a 30 second animated video from this HTML landing page I wrote.
My HyperFrames composition will not render; can you validate the project and fix it?
Turn our product's marketing page URL into a launch promo video for social.
Make a short changelog video explaining what pull request owner/repo#42 changed.
Turn this article about soil microbes into a narrated explainer video with no footage or presenter.
Make a video slideshow from these twelve holiday photos with captions and a gentle transition between each.
Create an animated title card and lower-third overlay for my podcast episode.
This draft newsletter reads like a chatbot wrote it. Make it sound like a person.
Edit this paragraph to remove the AI writing tells: the inflated words, the rule of three and the em dashes.
Convert this vendor invoice PDF into an Excel workbook with the line items and totals reconciled.
Find a royalty-free whoosh sound effect and background music for my HyperFrames project and add them to its ledger.
Explain the difference between a mutex and a semaphore in two sentences.
Write a two line reply thanking Sam for the meeting notes.
What is 17 percent of 2,340?
In one sentence, when is a bar chart better than a pie chart?
